data.one_liner: Community fork of the excel library to read, create, and edit XLSX and XLS files.
data.what_it_does: Reads, creates, and edits modern XLSX spreadsheets and legacy XLS files across platforms. Supports cell styling, formulas, charts, pivot tables, and data transformation.
use_when: You need to read, edit, or generate Excel spreadsheets programmatically in Flutter or Dart.
You require cross-platform support including Flutter Web, desktop, and mobile.
avoid_when: You need to stream rows one at a time for very large files without loading the whole workbook into memory.
strengths: High performance and speed for reading and writing large spreadsheet files.
Rich feature set including charts, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and cell protection.
Automatic format detection for both modern XLSX and legacy XLS files.
weaknesses: Does not currently support streaming rows to process massive workbooks without loading everything into memory.
